audience: recruiting teams that authorize a scoped Taleez secret API key

useCases.title: Review current job postings
useCases.text: Filter job postings by status or location, inspect a job and read its recruiting pipeline steps.

useCases.title: Look up a candidate’s applications
useCases.text: Find a candidate by email and inspect their profile, applications and current pipeline steps.

useCases.title: Inspect a talent pool
useCases.text: Find a talent pool and browse its candidates and their custom properties.

useCases.title: Add candidates to a pool
useCases.text: Find the intended talent pool and candidate records, then associate the selected candidates with that pool.

useCases.title: Update a candidate’s profile
useCases.text: Read an existing candidate profile and change the requested contact or profile fields. Existing stored values are overwritten for the supplied fields.
